defect_observations.observation: The non-strict comparison P(|S|>=t) >= 1/2 P(max|Y_i|>=t) is proved only by 'The same reasoning with M>=t'. The q_>= bounds and the exact source CDF form V.(5.10) depend on it.
The promised non-strict version of the symmetric maximal inequality is only sketched ('use the same argument').

Feller's printed (7.7) on p.235 has the integrand x*tau(x) in (2/t) int_0^t x tau(x) dx. The handbook's identity uses tau(y), which is the integration-by-parts result, and does not note that the printed source formula differs. The correction is silent.

Feller's printed Lemma (7.5) on p.235 has the coefficient 1/(n^2 x^2). The handbook states the n^{-1} scale and refutes an n^{-2} coefficient (body 306-310; annex 526 says 'corrected'), but never says that the n^{-2} form is the printed source reading.

Feller's symmetric example (p.236) uses the condition t[1-F(t)] -> 0. The handbook states the symmetric case under tau(t)->0. The one-line equivalence for symmetric laws, tP(|X|>t)=2t[1-F(t)], is not written.
For the half-open center, 'It therefore gives the same concentration conclusion' relies on the center-perturbation step. That step is only written later, in the corollary proof (annex 401-403).
The threshold counterexample for V.(5.10) silently takes n=1: it uses P(|Y_1|>1)=0 as the strict left side and never states the number of summands.

Proofs name results they use without a \ref: 'bounded fourth-moment lemma' (WA 259; thm:p15-bounded-fourth-moment), 'power-tail identity' (WA 398, 497; thm:p15-power-tail-tools), 'disjoint-group theorem' (WA 438), 'Feller's already proved theorem' (WA 563-564; thm:p15-feller-infinite-mean), 'countable independent sequence construction' (WA 573-574) and 'already proved convolution-density formula' (FA 437; thm:p15-convolution-density). Each target exists earlier on the route.
Feller V.(5.4), the general atomic symmetrization q_n = sum_k p_k p_{k+n} on p.149, is neither supplied nor named in the boundary, which names only (5.5). No listed component owes it.
